items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I don't think Basie was in that band at that time.

ctx.x: This was around '26 but Creath's band ...

No, I would say -- well, you may allow for a couple of years, maybe '26, it could be. Jimmy Rushing I had a lot of respect for Jimmy Rushing ... We never recorded together ... I don't think Basie was in that band at that time.
